/**
 * The detector registry, in precedence order. When several detectors fire on
 * the same call, the first one wins: environmental blockers and denials first
 * (they need the user), then exact repeats, then the looser patterns.
 * Adding a detector means one file, one entry here and its fixtures.
 */
import { cycle } from './cycle.ts'
import { deniedRetry } from './denied-retry.ts'
import { editThrash } from './edit-thrash.ts'
import { envBlocker } from './env-blocker.ts'
import { idleRepeat } from './idle-repeat.ts'
import { poll } from './poll.ts'
import { repeatFailure } from './repeat-failure.ts'
import { sameError } from './same-error.ts'
import type { Detector } from './shared.ts'

export type { Detector } from './shared.ts'

export const DETECTORS: readonly Detector[] = [
  envBlocker,
  deniedRetry,
  repeatFailure,
  sameError,
  editThrash,
  cycle,
  idleRepeat,
  poll,
]
